text:
alicia.evans: Creating RC rc-2028-04 with artifact sha: bc12f9a. Requesting pre-promo visibility checks and sign-offs. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. Pls ack and note any blocking telemetry gaps.

samir.k: Ack. Can we run the quick telemetry diff and the cache-warm smoke? I want to ensure prefix cache hit rates don't regress.

kevin.l: +1. Also calling out that Dedicated pools might need a transient capacity bump during canary. I've queued an infra request.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rc created: rc-2028-04 by alicia.evans (artifact bc12f9a). Canary plan default: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m intervals. To modify: `/deploy plan edit rc-2028-04 --canary 10% --step 20m`.

jen.m: Ran preflight smoke on staging a few mins ago. Quick results: generation latency p50 stable (+2ms), error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.11%). No obvious regressions from our standard prompt set. Full logs:```
staging-smoke summary:
- prompts: 120
- failures: 0
- avg p50: 118ms
- kv-cache hit: 86%
```

sre-oncall: Thanks Jen. For rollback decision, let's set thresholds: error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency > 500ms sustained for 5m -> auto-rollback. Also require manual watch during first canary step. I'll be oncall during the window.

samir.k: Noted. One more ask: add a quick query to ensure telemetry exports (datadog) include token-level cost for this RC. Last time the metric tag was missing and cost calc lagged.

alicia.evans: Good catch. I've updated the release notes and included a note for billing tagging. Patch: `telemetry.tag=rc-2028-04` in the collector config.

kevin.l: Infra bump is approved. I've set a burst pool +2 instances for the 02:00-03:00 UTC slot.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pre-promo checklist: artifact verified, canary plan present, smoke green, infra request attached, telemetry tag present. Ready for sign-off.

samir.k: I'm signing off for product/quality. :thumbsup:

jen.m: sign-off from QA. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: SRE sign-off with rollback rules in place. I'll run the canary watch and have the rollback playbook ready. :shield:

alicia.evans: Thanks all — scheduling promotion now. Command I'll run:```/deploy promote --rc rc-2028-04 --pin bc12f9a --window 02:00-04:00 --notes "rc-2028-04: latency perf tweaks + telemetry tags"```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Will post updates in thread during rollout.

kevin.l: If anything looks off, ping me immediately and I'll expand capacity or hit the kill-switch.

alicia.evans: Final: proceeding at scheduled time. Leaving this thread open for live updates.

(After promotion) deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary 5% started. Monitoring: errors 0.08%, p95 210ms.

jen.m: Observing traffic, no user-facing errors. Continued watch.

sre-oncall: Canary 5% stable for 20m. Proceed to 25%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary 25% started. Monitoring: errors 0.09%, p95 230ms.

samir.k: All looks nominal. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete: 100% traffic. rc-2028-04 pinned to prod as bc12f9a. Release notes updated. :tada:
